tooltip.simplearrows.light_arrow: Lights the spot where it sticks
tooltip.simplearrows.light_arrow.2: The light goes when the arrow despawns
text.autoconfig.simplearrows.title: Simple Arrows
text.autoconfig.simplearrows.option.silv:
Extra damage of a silver arrow against undead mobs (zombies, skeletons, ...). 0 = like a normal arrow. Range 0 to 6.
Default: 3.
text.autoconfig.simplearrows.option.ligh:
A Light Arrow stuck in a block lights the air in front of it (level 15) until the arrow despawns or is picked up. Off = a plain arrow.
Default: on.
